package.outcome: Go from an installed toolchain to a project that checks clean, builds, and can tell you what it contains — a first session with s0ma, start to finish.

recovery.action: Your file asked for something this environment cannot import. Ask for the health report: it says which s0ma packages are installed here and whether it can see your project at all, which is the question a missing import raises. If something is genuinely absent, install it again by the route you first used.

The check stopped before it could read the file and named it, along with the value it would not accept. Repair that value in the source you wrote and ask the same question again — nothing is built from a file the toolchain cannot read, so there is nothing else to undo.
